source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 7 (PDF 93-106), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 7 (Hypothesis Testing) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Write the two student learning outcomes of this chapter.
(Is chapter ke do student learning outcomes likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Hypotheses (mafrooze) banana aur hypothesis testing karna seekhna.
2. Findings ko advanced data visuals se batana aur unhein wapas hypotheses se jorna seekhna.

book_ref.quote: Learn how to form hypotheses and perform hypothesis testing.

blocks.prompt:
2 What does hypothesis testing check? Give one benefit of this method.
(Hypothesis testing kya check karta hai? Is tareeqe ka aik faida likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hypothesis testing data se check karta hai ke koi mafroza (assumption) sahi hai ya ghalat, taake daawa qubool ya radd ho. Faida: yeh saboot par mabni (evidence-based) faisle deta hai, is liye andaza kam hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It checks whether an assumption is true or false.

blocks.prompt:
3 Why must a hypothesis be clear and measurable? How does a correct hypothesis help a study?
(Hypothesis wazeh aur measurable kyun hona chahiye? Durust hypothesis study ki kaise madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hypothesis aik nateeje ki peshgoi karta hai jise data se check kiya jata hai, is liye use wazeh aur measurable (naapne ke qabil) hona chahiye. Durust hypothesis analysis ki rehnumai karta hai aur study ko markooz rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: A correct hypothesis guides analysis.

blocks.prompt:
4 Write the hypothesis function used in a model and name its symbols.
(Model mein istemal hone wala hypothesis function likhein aur us ki alamaat ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
hθ(x) = y
hθ(x): parameters θ ke saath input x par lagaya gaya hypothesis function; x: input features ya data points; y: predicted output ya target value; θ: model ke parameters ya weights (wazan), jaise linear regression ke coefficients.

book_ref.quote: The hypothesis function with parameters (θ) applied to input (x).

blocks.prompt:
5 Differentiate between a research question and a hypothesis.
(Research question aur hypothesis mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Research question batata hai kya study ho raha hai; hypothesis us se bana mumkina jawab hai.

book_ref.quote: Clear questions lead to clear hypotheses.

rows: Batata hai ke kya study ho raha hai.
Research question se banaya jata hai.
Data jama karne ki rehnumai karta hai.
Mumkina jawab deta hai jise test kiya jata hai.
Misal: Kya parhai ka waqt exam scores par asar daalta hai?
Misal: H₁: Parhai ka waqt exam scores par numayan asar daalta hai.

blocks.prompt:
6 How are research questions and hypotheses connected? Give two points.
(Research questions aur hypotheses ka aapas mein kya talluq hai? Do nukaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Hypothesis research question se banta hai; wazeh sawal wazeh hypothesis dete hain.
2. Sawal data collection ki rehnumai karte hain aur hypotheses analysis ko markooz kar ke study ki simt behtar karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Hypotheses make the analysis focused.

blocks.text: Role of Hypothesis Testing in Data Analysis

blocks.prompt:
7 Give any two roles of hypothesis testing in data analysis.
(Data analysis mein hypothesis testing ke koi do kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Yeh data ko mantiqi tor par parakh kar dekhta hai ke nataij ba-maani hain, aur random nataij se bachata hai.
2. Yeh nataij ko tawaqqo se milata hai taake faisle saboot par hon, jis se nataij par aitmaad barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: It compares results with expectations.

blocks.prompt:
8 Name two areas where hypothesis testing is used, according to the book.
(Kitab ke mutabiq hypothesis testing kin do jagahon par istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hypothesis testing durusti (accuracy) ki himayat karta hai aur experiments aur surveys mein istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Hypothesis testing supports accuracy

blocks.prompt:
9 Name the two most common types of hypotheses. How do they work in testing?
(Hypotheses ki do sab se aam qismon ke naam likhein. Yeh testing mein kaise kaam karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Null hypothesis (H₀) aur alternative hypothesis (H₁ ya Ha). Dono mil kar kaam karte hain: data ko H₀ ke khilaf parakha jata hai, aur saboot mazboot ho to H₀ radd kar ke H₁ ki himayat hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: These types work together in testing.

blocks.prompt:
10 Why is the null hypothesis called a default assumption? When is it rejected?
(Null hypothesis ko default assumption kyun kehte hain? Yeh kab radd hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh pehle se maana hua mafroza hai ke koi asar ya farq nahin; data ko isi ke khilaf parakha jata hai. Yeh sirf tab radd hota hai jab is ke khilaf saboot mazboot ho.

book_ref.quote: Data is tested against this hypothesis.

blocks.prompt:
11 Give two uses of the null hypothesis.
(Null hypothesis ke do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Yeh bias (tarafdari) se bachata hai.
2. Yeh muqable ki bunyad deta hai jis ke khilaf data parakha jata hai; bohat se tests isi se shuru hote hain.

book_ref.quote: It provides a comparison base.

blocks.prompt:
12 Differentiate between the null hypothesis and the alternative hypothesis.
(Null hypothesis aur alternative hypothesis mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: H₀ kehta hai koi asar ya farq nahin; H₁ kehta hai asar ya farq hai.

book_ref.quote: It is written as opposite of the null hypothesis.

rows: Kehta hai ke koi asar ya farq nahin.
Kehta hai ke asar ya farq maujood hai.
Alamat H₀.
Alamat H₁ ya Ha.
Default mafroza; data isi ke khilaf parakha jata hai.
Null hypothesis ka ulat likha jata hai.
Saboot mazboot ho to radd hota hai.
Qubool karne ke liye saboot mazboot ho; tabdeeli ya asar zahir karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
13 A shopkeeper asks: 'Does a discount increase daily sales?' Write H₀ and H₁ for this question.
(Dukaandar poochhta hai: 'Kya discount se rozana sales barhti hai?' Is sawal ke liye H₀ aur H₁ likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
H₀: Discount ka rozana sales par koi asar nahin (koi farq nahin).
H₁: Discount se rozana sales barhti hai (asar hai).

book_ref.quote: Alternative hypotheses guide research direction.

blocks.prompt:
14 What is often the goal of testing with respect to the alternative hypothesis? What does H₁ represent?
(Alternative hypothesis ke hawale se testing ka maqsad aksar kya hota hai? H₁ kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Testing ka maqsad aksar alternative hypothesis ki himayat hota hai, lekin qubool karne ke liye saboot mazboot hona chahiye. H₁ tabdeeli ya asar zahir karta hai aur mutawaqqa nateeja batata hai.

book_ref.quote: The goal of testing is often to support this hypothesis.

blocks.prompt:
15 Write any four rules for formulating correct hypotheses.
(Durust hypotheses banane ke koi chaar usool likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Wazeh aur makhsoos (specific) hon.
2. Data se testable hon.
3. Research questions se mel khayein.
4. Variables wazeh tor par aur aasan zaban mein bayan hon.

book_ref.quote: They should be testable using data.

blocks.prompt:
16 'Study affects marks somehow.' Why is this a poor hypothesis? Rewrite it correctly.
('Parhai kisi tarah marks par asar daalti hai.' Yeh kamzor hypothesis kyun hai? Ise durust likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh mubham (vague) hai: variables wazeh nahin aur bayan makhsoos nahin; mubham bayan durusti kam karte hain. Behtar: H₁: Parhai ka waqt students ke exam scores par numayan asar daalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Proper hypotheses improve analysis quality.

blocks.prompt:
17 Name four key concepts used in hypothesis testing.
(Hypothesis testing mein istemal hone wale chaar ahem concepts ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Test statistics, critical region, significance level (α) aur p-value. Har aik ka khaas kirdar hai aur yeh mil kar hypotheses qubool ya radd karne mein istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Each concept has a specific role in testing.

blocks.prompt:
18 Write the formula of the t-value and name its symbols.
(t-value ka formula likhein aur us ki alamaat ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
t = (x̄ − μ₀) / (s/√n)
x̄: sample mean; μ₀: null hypothesis ke tehat population mean; s: sample standard deviation; n: sample size.

book_ref.quote: Test statistics help compare results and support decisions.

blocks.prompt:
19 A sample of 49 students has a mean of 84 and a standard deviation of 14. Find t if μ₀ = 80.
(49 students ke sample ka mean 84 aur standard deviation 14 hai. Agar μ₀ = 80 ho to t maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: we want to test if the mean score is significantly different from the population mean of 75

blocks.prompt:
20 Calculate t for n = 9, x̄ = 58, s = 6 and μ₀ = 55.
(n = 9, x̄ = 58, s = 6 aur μ₀ = 55 ke liye t nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The sample standard deviation is 10.

blocks.prompt:
21 Write the chi-square formula and name its symbols.
(Chi-square ka formula likhein aur us ki alamaat ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
χ² = Σ (Oᵢ − Eᵢ)² / Eᵢ
Oᵢ: har category ki observed (dekhi gayi) frequency; Eᵢ: har category ki expected (mutawaqqa) frequency.

book_ref.quote: Observed frequency in each category

blocks.prompt:
22 A fair die rolled 60 times shows faces 1 to 6 with frequencies 8, 11, 9, 13, 10, 9. Find χ².
(Aik fair dice 60 baar phenkne par 1 se 6 tak ki frequencies 8, 11, 9, 13, 10, 9 hain. χ² nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Har face ke liye E = 60/6 = 10.
χ² = (4 + 1 + 1 + 9 + 0 + 1)/10 = 16/10 = 1.6
Yeh qeemat Chi-Square table ki critical value se milai jati hai.

book_ref.quote: and we would compare this value against the critical value from the Chi-Square distribution table

blocks.prompt:
23 What happens if the test statistic falls in the critical region? On what does this region depend?
(Agar test statistic critical region mein gire to kya hota hai? Yeh region kis par munhasar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar test statistic critical region mein gire to null hypothesis radd ho jata hai. Yeh region testing se pehle tay hota hai aur significance level par munhasar hai.

book_ref.quote: If test statistics fall in this region, the null hypothesis is rejected.

blocks.prompt:
24 Give two ways in which the critical region helps in hypothesis testing.
(Critical region hypothesis testing mein kin do tareeqon se madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Yeh intehai nataij dikhata hai, is liye radd/na-radd ka faisla karne mein madad deta hai.
2. Testing se pehle tay hone ki wajah se ghair yaqeeniyat kam karta hai; graphs aksar ise dikhate hain.

book_ref.quote: Critical regions help make decisions.

blocks.prompt:
25 What does the significance level show? Give its common value.
(Significance level kya dikhata hai? Is ki aam qeemat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Significance level (α) ghalti ka khatra dikhata hai aur batata hai ke test kitna sakht hai. Aam qeemat 0.05 hai.

book_ref.quote: It defines how strict a test is.

blocks.prompt:
26 Which test is stricter, one with α = 0.05 or one with α = 0.01? Give reason.
(Kaun sa test zyada sakht hai, α = 0.05 wala ya α = 0.01 wala? Wajah likhein.)
blocks.explanation: α = 0.01 wala test zyada sakht hai, kyunke significance level ki kam qeemat ka matlab zyada sakht testing hai.

book_ref.quote: Proper choice improves reliability.

blocks.prompt:
27 Differentiate between the significance level and the p-value.
(Significance level aur p-value mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: α analysis se pehle chuni gayi hadd hai; p-value data se aata hai aur α se milaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Significance level controls false results

rows: Ghalti ka khatra aur test ki sakhti dikhata hai.
Null hypothesis ke khilaf saboot ki taqat dikhata hai.
Analysis se pehle chuna jata hai (aam qeemat 0.05).
Test statistics nikalne ke baad maloom hota hai.
H₀ sach hone par use radd karne ka zyada se zyada imkaan.
H₀ sach hone ki soorat mein dekhe gaye ya us se zyada intehai nateeje ka imkaan.

blocks.prompt:
28 Why does a small p-value support rejection of the null hypothesis?
(Chhota p-value null hypothesis ke radd ki himayat kyun karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chhota p-value batata hai ke agar H₀ sach hota to dekha gaya nateeja ittefaq se aana mushkil tha, is liye H₀ ke khilaf saboot mazboot hai.

book_ref.quote: A small p-value supports the rejection of the null hypothesis

blocks.prompt:
29 With α = 0.05, a test gives p = 0.12. What is the decision? Give reason.
(α = 0.05 ke saath test p = 0.12 deta hai. Faisla kya hoga? Wajah likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Null hypothesis radd nahin hoga, kyunke p-value (0.12) α (0.05) se bara hai, is liye H₀ ke khilaf saboot kafi mazboot nahin.

book_ref.quote: the null hypothesis may be rejected

blocks.prompt:
30 Give two benefits of a clear understanding of p-values.
(p-values ko achhi tarah samajhne ke do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. p-values statistical faislon ko aasan banate hain aur data par mabni nataij ki himayat karte hain.
2. Achhi samajh ghaltiyon se bachati hai, jaise baghair saboot ke hypothesis qubool ya radd karna.

book_ref.quote: P-values help simplify statistical decisions and support data-driven conclusions.

blocks.prompt:
31 Write the stages of the hypothesis testing process shown in Figure 7.1.
(Figure 7.1 mein dikhaye gaye hypothesis testing ke amal ke marahil likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hypotheses define karna → data ehtiyat se jama karna → test statistics nikalna → nataij ko criteria se milana → faisla karna.

book_ref.quote: Test statistics are calculated. Results are compared with criteria.

blocks.prompt:
32 Which two steps come after calculating the test statistics?
(Test statistics nikalne ke baad kaun se do steps aate hain?)
blocks.explanation:
1. p-value nikala jata hai.
2. Nateeje ko significance level se mila kar qubool ya radd ka faisla kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: A decision is made to accept or reject.

blocks.prompt:
33 Why is the significance level selected before the data is collected?
(Data jama karne se pehle significance level kyun chuna jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Significance level batata hai ke test kitna sakht hai aur yeh analysis se pehle chuna jata hai, is liye steps mein yeh hypotheses ke foran baad aur samples se data jama karne se pehle chuna jata hai.

book_ref.quote: First, null and alternative hypotheses are defined.

blocks.prompt:
34 Give two simple examples of hypothesis testing. How are their results obtained?
(Hypothesis testing ki do aasan misalein dein. Un ke nataij kaise hasil hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Exam results ki testing aur ausat qad (height) check karna. Samples se data jama hota hai, basic tests se analyze hota hai aur wazeh nataij nikale jate hain.

book_ref.quote: One example is testing exam results.

blocks.text: Advanced Tests: F-Test and Chi-Square Test

blocks.prompt:
35 Differentiate between the F-test and the Chi-Square test.
(F-test aur Chi-Square test mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: F-test variances milata hai; Chi-Square test categorical data mein talluqat check karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The Chi-Square test checks relationships.

rows: Variances milata hai.
Talluqat check karta hai.
Analysis of variance mein istemal hota hai.
Categorical data ke saath istemal hota hai.
F = S₁²/S₂²
χ² = Σ (Oᵢ − Eᵢ)²/Eᵢ
F-value ko F-table ki critical value se milate hain.
χ² ko Chi-Square table ki critical value se milate hain.

blocks.prompt:
36 Two groups of students have variances 36 and 12. Calculate the F-value.
(Students ke do groups ke variances 36 aur 12 hain. F-value nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
F = S₁²/S₂² = 36/12 = 3.0
Yeh F-value F-table ki critical value se milai jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Suppose we have two groups of students:

blocks.prompt:
37 In the book's worked example, why is the p-value about 0.000012 and not 0.00002?
(Kitab ki hal shuda misal mein p-value taqreeban 0.000012 kyun hai, 0.00002 kyun nahin?)
blocks.explanation: H₁ μ > 70 hai, is liye test one-tailed (aik taraf wala) hai. t = 7.93 aur df = 9 ke liye one-tailed p taqreeban 0.000012 hai; 0.00002 two-tailed qeemat hai. Dono soorton mein p < 0.05 aur H₀ radd.

book_ref.quote: Using the t-distribution table or statistical software

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: One-tailed test mein sirf aik simt (yahan 'zyada') ka imkaan dekha jata hai, is liye p-value two-tailed ka taqreeban aadha hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
38 Write the formula of the sample standard deviation used in the worked example. Why is n − 1 used?
(Hal shuda misal mein sample standard deviation ka formula likhein. n − 1 kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
s = √( Σ(xᵢ − x̄)² / (n − 1) )
n − 1 sample ke degrees of freedom hain (df = n − 1); misal mein df = 10 − 1 = 9.

book_ref.quote: Step 4: Calculate Standard Deviation

blocks.prompt:
39 Give two ways in which data visualization supports hypothesis testing.
(Data visualization hypothesis testing ki kin do tareeqon se madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Statistical tests se pehle patterns, trends aur talluqat dekhne mein madad deta hai.
2. Tasveeri saboot de kar behtar faisle mein madad karta hai aur outliers aur anomalies pehchanne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: It supports better decision-making by providing visual evidence.

blocks.prompt:
40 What do visual tools highlight in data? Who benefits from them?
(Visual tools data mein kya numayan karte hain? In se kis ko faida hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Visual tools data mein trends, distributions aur variations wazeh karte hain. Yeh technical aur non-technical dono logon ke liye nataij samjhana aasan banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Visual tools highlight trends, distributions, and variations in data clearly.

blocks.prompt:
41 How does visualization help with large datasets?
(Visualization bare datasets mein kaise madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bare datasets ko sirf adad se samajhna mushkil hai; visualization unhein jaldi samajhne mein madad deta hai aur ghair mamooli patterns dikha kar ghaltiyan kam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It helps researchers quickly understand large datasets

blocks.text: Graphs and Charts for Presenting Results

blocks.prompt:
42 Differentiate between a bar chart and a pie chart.
(Bar chart aur pie chart mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Bar chart groups milata hai; pie chart kul ke hisse dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: These visual tools make results more attractive, clear, and easier to interpret

rows: Categories ya groups ka muqabla karne ke liye mufeed.
Hisse (proportions) aur percentages dikhata hai.
Misal: mukhtalif groups ke ausat marks saath saath.
Misal: kul mein har group ka percentage hissa.

blocks.prompt:
43 Differentiate between a line graph and a scatter plot.
(Line graph aur scatter plot mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Line graph waqt ke saath tabdeeli dikhata hai; scatter plot do variables ka talluq dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Graphs and charts are commonly used tools for presenting results in hypothesis testing.

rows: Waqt ke saath trends aur tabdeeliyan dikhata hai.
Do variables ke darmiyan talluq dikhata hai.
Hypothesis testing mein trends peshgoi ki tasdeeq kar sakte hain.
Hypothesis mein bayan kiye gaye talluqat pehchanne mein madad deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
44 Name a suitable chart for each: (1) a school's pass percentage over five years, (2) share of each subject choice among students.
(Har aik ke liye munasib chart batayein: (1) school ka paanch saal ka pass percentage, (2) students mein har subject ke intikhab ka hissa.)
blocks.explanation:
(1) Line graph, kyunke yeh waqt ke saath trends aur tabdeeliyan dikhata hai.
(2) Pie chart, kyunke yeh hisse aur percentages dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Line graphs show trends and changes over time.

blocks.prompt:
45 How do data visuals link results with a hypothesis? Give one example.
(Data visuals nataij ko hypothesis se kaise jorte hain? Aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh researchers ko tasveer mein dekhne dete hain ke data hypothesis ki himayat karta hai ya use radd karta hai. Misal: comparison graph control aur experimental groups ka farq dikha sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: They allow researchers to visually check whether the data support or reject the hypothesis.

blocks.prompt:
46 A hypothesis states that more study time gives higher marks. Which visual helps check it, and why?
(Hypothesis kehta hai ke zyada parhai se zyada marks aate hain. Kaun sa visual ise check karne mein madad dega aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Parhai ke waqt aur marks ka scatter plot, kyunke scatter plot hypothesis mein bayan kiye gaye do variables ke talluq ko pehchanne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Scatter plots help identify relationships stated in the hypothesis.

blocks.text: 7.6 Ethical Issues in Data Science and Analysis

blocks.prompt:
47 What do ethical practices ensure in data science? What must data scientists follow?
(Data science mein akhlaqi tareeqe kya yaqeeni banate hain? Data scientists ko kis cheez ki pabandi karni chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Akhlaqi tareeqe data par mabni faislon mein insaaf, durusti aur aitmaad yaqeeni banate hain. Data scientists data jama karte, process karte aur tashreeh karte waqt akhlaqi usoolon ki pabandi karein.

book_ref.quote: Ethical practices ensure fairness, accuracy, and trust in data-driven decisions.

blocks.prompt:
48 Give two results of ethical awareness in data science.
(Data science mein akhlaqi shaoor ke do nataij likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Akhlaqi shaoor data science applications par awam ka aitmaad qaim rakhta hai.
2. Akhlaqi data science privacy bachati hai aur imtiyaz se bachati hai; zimmedarana istemal technology par aitmaad banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Ethical awareness helps maintain public confidence in data science applications.

blocks.text: Bias in Data Collection and Analysis

blocks.prompt:
49 Differentiate between sampling bias and confirmation bias.
(Sampling bias aur confirmation bias mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Sampling bias data mein kaun shamil hai is mein hota hai; confirmation bias researcher ke data dekhne ke andaz mein.

book_ref.quote: Sampling Bias: A health study includes only young adults

rows: Jab sample tamam groups ki numaindagi na kare.
Jab researcher sirf apne khayal ki himayat wala data dekhe.
Data collection ke dauran hota hai.
Analysis ke dauran, zaati mafroozat se hota hai.
Misal: sehat ki study mein sirf jawan log, is liye boorhon ki numaindagi nahin.
Misal: mukhalif nataij nazar andaz kar diye jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
50 Give two harmful effects of bias in data.
(Data mein bias ke do nuqsanat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Biased data ghalat aur gumrah kun nataij deta hai.
2. Bias faislon par asar daal kar na-munsifana nataij ko mazboot kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Biased data leads to inaccurate and misleading analysis results.

blocks.prompt:
51 Explain gender bias and geographical bias with one example each.
(Gender bias aur geographical bias ko aik aik misal se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Gender bias: hiring dataset mein zyada tar mard umeedwar, is liye model mardon ko tarjeeh deta hai.
Geographical bias: sirf shehri ilaqon ka data dehi aabadi ke faislon ke liye istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Gender Bias: A hiring dataset contains mostly male candidates

blocks.prompt:
52 How can bias be reduced to get fair results?
(Munsifana nataij ke liye bias kaise kam kiya ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bias ko pehchan kar kam karna zaroori hai: data ehtiyat se jama ho taake tamam groups ki munsifana numaindagi ho, aur analysis zaati mafroozat ke baghair be-laag (objective) ho.

book_ref.quote: Identifying and mitigating bias is essential for reliable results.

blocks.text: Ethical Use of Data and Models

blocks.prompt:
53 Write any four points of the ethical use of data and models.
(Data aur models ke akhlaqi istemal ke koi chaar nukaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Logon ki privacy aur raazdari ka ehtiram.
2. Durust ijazat (consent) se data lena aur sirf usi maqsad ke liye istemal.
3. Machine learning models ko imtiyaz se pak design karna.
4. Hassas data ko ghair mutalliqa rasai (unauthorized access) se bachana.

book_ref.quote: Ethical use of data involves respecting privacy and confidentiality of individuals.

blocks.prompt:
54 What is the role of ethical guidelines and transparency for predictive models?
(Predictive models ke liye akhlaqi usool aur shaffafiyat ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Akhlaqi usool predictive models ke ghalat istemal ko rokte hain, aur model design ki shaffafiyat users mein aitmaad banati hai; zimmedarana istemal mosbat samaji asar deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Ethical guidelines help prevent misuse of predictive models.

blocks.prompt:
55 Write any three rules of responsible communication of findings.
(Findings ki zimmedarana tarseel ke koi teen usool likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Nataij imandari se, baghair mubalighe ya hera pheri ke pesh karein.
2. Data aur analysis ki hudood wazeh bayan karein.
3. Gumrah kun visuals aur selective reporting se bachein.

book_ref.quote: Results should be presented honestly without exaggeration or manipulation.

blocks.prompt:
56 What does ethical communication of findings prevent?
(Findings ki akhlaqi tarseel kis cheez ko rokti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Akhlaqi tarseel findings ki ghalat tashreeh aur ghalat istemal ko rokti hai; wazeh wazahat stakeholders ko nataij durust samajhne mein madad deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Ethical communication prevents misinterpretation and misuse of findings.

blocks.prompt:
57 Why is clear communication of results necessary? Give two reasons.
(Nataij ki wazeh tarseel kyun zaroori hai? Do wajuhat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Is se nataij ghalat samjhe ya istemal nahin hote, aur parhne wale samajhte hain ke kya faisle ho sakte hain.
2. Is se shaffafiyat aur aitbaar barhta hai aur aainda research ki madad hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Clear communication ensures that results are not misunderstood or misused.

blocks.prompt:
58 What does interpreting test results involve?
(Test results ki tashreeh mein kya shamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Statistical nataij ka matlab samajhna: p-values, confidence levels ya test statistics ka jaiza le kar faisla karna ke hypothesis qubool hai ya radd, data ke context ko dekhte hue.

book_ref.quote: Results help determine whether a hypothesis is accepted or rejected.

blocks.prompt:
59 Give one danger of misinterpretation and one benefit of proper interpretation of results.
(Nataij ki ghalat tashreeh ka aik nuqsan aur durust tashreeh ka aik faida likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Nuqsan: ghalat tashreeh ghalat conclusions tak le jati hai.
Faida: durust tashreeh qabil-e-aitmaad aur ba-maani findings deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Proper interpretation ensures reliable and meaningful findings.

blocks.prompt:
60 How should a conclusion be connected to the original hypothesis?
(Conclusion ko asal hypothesis se kaise jorna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Researcher wazeh bataye ke hypothesis ki himayat hui ya nahin, aur conclusion ka jawaz data aur test results se ho, zaati raaye se nahin.

book_ref.quote: Researchers should clearly state whether the hypothesis is supported or not.

blocks.prompt:
61 Give two benefits of connecting conclusions to hypotheses.
(Conclusions ko hypotheses se jorne ke do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Wazeh talluq research ki sehat (validity) ko mazboot karta hai.
2. Mantiqi yaksaniyat yaqeeni banata hai aur research ka amal moassar tareeqe se mukammal karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Clear connections strengthen the validity of research.

blocks.prompt:
62 Write any three ways to present findings clearly.
(Findings ko wazeh pesh karne ke koi teen tareeqe likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Nataij mantiqi aur munazzam tareeqe se tarteeb dein.
2. Wazahat ke liye tables, charts aur graphs istemal karein.
3. Jargon ki jagah aasan zaban aur ahem nukaat numayan karein.

book_ref.quote: Tables, charts, and graphs can be used to support explanations.

blocks.prompt:
63 What are the benefits of presenting findings clearly?
(Findings wazeh pesh karne ke kya faide hain?)
blocks.explanation: Wazeh pesh kash uljhan kam karti hai aur tarseel behtar karti hai; achhi tarah pesh ki gayi findings research ko zyada moassar aur mufeed banati hain.

book_ref.quote: Clear presentation reduces confusion and improves communication.

blocks.prompt:
64 What is a decision rule? Write the decision rule based on the p-value.
(Decision rule kya hai? p-value par mabni decision rule likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Decision rule se faisla hota hai ke null hypothesis radd karna hai ya nahin. Usool: agar p-value < α ho to H₀ radd; warna H₀ radd nahin hota.

book_ref.quote: For example, if (p-value < α), the null hypothesis is rejected.

blocks.prompt:
65 Define communicating results.
(Communicating results ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Communicating results ka matlab findings ko wazeh, durust aur asal hypothesis ke hawale se pesh karna hai taake parhne wale conclusion samajh sakein.

book_ref.quote: Communicating results means presenting findings clearly, accurately, and in relation to the original hypothesis

blocks.prompt:
66 Define hypothesis testing as given in the summary.
(Summary ke mutabiq hypothesis testing ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hypothesis testing aik statistical tareeqa hai jis se faisla hota hai ke sample data mein kisi daawe ki himayat ya radd ke liye kafi saboot hai ya nahin.

book_ref.quote: is a statistical method used to decide whether there is enough evidence in sample data
